note: Mayes County has no queryable zoning district layer. The county publishes no zoning service; its zoning maps are obtained through offices. The largest city, Pryor Creek, publishes its 2023 zoning map only as a PDF. Locust Grove's zoning is in its town code, with no map service found. Zoning Atlas says only a few of the county's jurisdictions have zoning. ArcGIS searches for Mayes zoning returned no district layer. The only zoning-attribute source is Regrid, a commercial parcel product, so it was not used.
